item.title: Few voters, big stakes: ‘Jungle’ primary draws just 433 early ballots
item.description: Advance voting for Tuesday’s six-way special election for Georgia House District 130 ended with only a few hundred votes cast, signaling extremely low turnout in the south Augusta race.
